'''Tysara''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Tarasin]] who lived during the waning years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
Tysara lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]], where she was the [[Mother (title)/Legends|Mother]] of a Tarasin [[irstat]]. During the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a number of Tarasin were kidnapped by the [[Slavery/Legends|slaver]] [[Haast Aath]], so Tysara hired the [[Heroes of Cularin]] to rescue them.
